facts.fact: In ch 25 Ila slits the side seam of her pattu in the second lake hut and caches the five sheets in the black gap where the plank shelf meets the wall, a hand deep, while Kunal sifts the hearth ash with his back to her. The queen's letter stays sewn in the hem. She does not carry the sheets to the Drum fold.
In the hut Ila's feet are wooden and only her smallest toes still answer; total loss of feeling comes on the shore near the sixtieth pace.
Hari has scratched his warnings on stones for thirty winters (F451); Ila reasons Raghu would not leave him standing once he has the sheets.
